اعتقلتم (form VIII)
# اِعْتَقَلْتُمْ (iʕtaqaltum) /iʕ.ta.qal.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# اُعْتُقِلْتُمْ (uʕtuqiltum) /uʕ.tu.qil.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
